insights.theme: Costs are not clear until the end
insights.summary: Students lose trust when the price or what it includes changes late in the booking.
evidence: The total price changed between the listing page and the payment page and nobody explained why.
Please show the full cost upfront.

insights.summary: Repeated upload failures block students who are otherwise ready to book.
evidence: I uploaded my passport twice and the page still says document missing.
The upload button is broken on every phone.

user_stories.title: Show the full cost on the listing page
user_stories.story: As a student comparing rooms, I want to see the full cost on the listing page, so that the payment page holds no surprises.
acceptance_criteria: The listing page shows rent, deposit and every fee.
The payment page total equals the listing page total.

stakeholder_email.subject: Booking drop-off: what students told us
stakeholder_email.body:
Hi team,

Two themes stand out in this batch of feedback: unclear costs and failed document uploads.

Thanks

risks.mitigation: Audit the fee fields before building.

risks.risk: Upload fix needs a vendor change
